title: Rule outcomes-mechanize-rules allows a timer whose record shows it pays
why: An owner ruling in the restart plan has no step, so its prose change would be lost at the archive.
source: Keep-warm part 1, owner 13:22 CST Nov 11, "A on keeping sessions warm too"; plan restart-plan 2c8af8f; retrospective 20:43 CST Nov 11
note: Rule outcomes-mechanize-rules keeps its reason and drops the blanket "never on a timer"; a timer is allowed when its record shows it costs less than it saves.
